name: event_id
description: Unique event identifier within a workflow_events landing copy (first by event_time wins, ADR-041).

name: event_time
description: Event UTC timestamp partitioning the append-only workflow_events copy.

name: event_type
description: Canonical event taxonomy name (outcome.*, action.committed, guardrail.intervention, state.transition, etc.).

name: source_system
description: Emitting system or service identifier.

name: trace_id
description: Associated W3C 32-hex trace identifier.

name: span_id
description: Associated W3C 16-hex span identifier.

name: response_id
description: Associated gen_ai.response.id provider response identifier.

name: outcome_id
description: Primary EVAL-P11 outcome.id associated with the event.

name: conversation_id
description: Associated gen_ai.conversation.id multi-turn session key.

name: action_id
description: Mutating action correlation identifier linking approvals, tool calls, and commits.

name: nudge_id
description: Optional per-recommendation output identifier.

name: control_id
description: Guardrail control identifier on guardrail.intervention rows.

name: control_layer
description: Guardrail enforcement layer (gateway, dlp, model_armor, app_rule).

name: control_action
description: Guardrail action (block, redact, shadow).

name: action_args
description: Raw JSON object {"tool_name": ..., "args": ...} hashed by Silver via RFC 8785 JCS (writers never send hashes).

name: approved_expires_at
description: Optional approval expiry UTC timestamp on outcome.approved rows.

name: user_id
description: Requester user identifier (restricted downstream only).

name: tenant_id
description: Tenant boundary identifier (restricted downstream only).

name: actor_id
description: Approver, reviewer, or committing actor identifier for Segregation-of-Duties checks.

name: payload_json
description: Unstructured JSON payload holding registered lifted keys (linked_outcome_id, outcome_status, feedback_reason, state_transition_to).
